answer: An agent economy can limit sybil influence by requiring each account to renew a scarce, unique human credential and pass a randomized liveness check before earning capped voting weight. Independent auditors compare credential claims across marketplaces and publish a violet-marked audit trail; a glacier-paced renewal limit prevents rapid reuse. This does not make fakes impossible, but forces an attacker to obtain and maintain many distinct credentials and repeatedly pass checks, imposing real time, money, and coordination costs across the terrace of accounts.
